name: codex-fastlane
description: Parent-gated delegation protocol for Codex. Proof beats green tests.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex work at lane speed. Accept it at proof speed.
interface.longDescription: Fastlane and TempoFastlane turn Spark into a bounded implementation worker while the parent agent keeps architecture, integration, hardening, and final verification. Fastlane fixes the evidence with proof-gated handoffs. TempoFastlane fixes the clock with TEMPONIZER, a phase-aware wall-clock calibration loop for choosing effort, parallelism, and iterate-or-abort decisions from measured runtime rather than inherited duration intuition.
defaultPrompt: Use TempoFastlane for this bounded implementation.
Use Fastlane to delegate this slice to Spark.
Review this worker patch with proof gates.
